sentences.text: At the very outset, counsel for the applicants states that the applicants pray for liberty that they will surrender before the court below and apply for bail.

It is therefore, directed that in case the applicants surrender and prefer bail application before the court below within one month, it will decide the said bail application as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within one month thereafter.

It is further provided that while deciding the bail application of the applicants, the court below will take into account the law laid down by the Narottam Agarwal And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 28 June, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121849619/

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed with a prayer to quash/set aside the cognizance and summoning order dated 10.07.2020 passed by First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kheri in Case No. 2008 of 2021 (Old Case No. 2643 of 2020) (State Vs. Radheshyam Agarwal and Others),
under Sections 26(2)(i)(ii)/51 and 59(i) of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, Police Station - Paliya, District - Kheri, with a further prayer to stay the further proceedings of the aforesaid case.

opennyai_summary.decision:
It is therefore, directed that in case the applicants surrender and prefer bail application before the court below within one month, it will decide the said bail application as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within one month thereafter.
Supreme Court in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation And Another passed in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No(s). 5191 of 2021 on 07.10.2021 and decide it in accordance with law.
The application stands disposed of.
